summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that its CEO will present at the 2026 Alaska Sustainable Energy Conference in Anchorage from May 19-21. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 and provides standard administrative updates, including a list of conference speakers and a link to the CEO's presentation. It contains no transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. This is a routine current report with no special-situation event; the category is None.
